name: AAP
description: Request approval for tool calls from an AAP provider.

binary.description: Path to the aap adapter binary. Resolved through PATH when not absolute.

approvalTimeoutMs.description: How long a gated tool call may wait for a human decision. The plugin registers its hook with this ceiling plus a margin; the provider deadline lands inside it.

configDir.description: Absolute AAP configuration directory written by the installer.
